hard_gates.gate: G1 tenant isolation (live attack on the product as built)
hard_gates.evidence: I attacked from the clean clone's demo, signed in as admin@alnoor.example against gulfsteel. attack-api-lists.txt: GET, PUT and DELETE on B's personal and shared view ids, through both views/{id} and shared-views/{id}, all got 404, and B's views kept their versions. A's views listing did not contain B's canary. Searches and filters for gulfsteel returned total 0. B's keyset cursor in A's query gave only A's rows. A's group counts add up to A's total of 100,005. The filtered CSV export held no gulfsteel row. Anonymous calls with X-Tenant-Id, X-Tenant or X-Workspace got 401. attack-sweep-get.txt: 523 GETs covered every GET route in the OpenAPI document (69 paths). They used B's user, role, company, branch, access and view ids, plus B's search terms, filter and cursor, in JSON and CSV. Result: 0 leaks across 217 markers. attack-sweep-write.txt: 912 POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE calls on every write route that takes an id, using B's ids, got only 400 or 404. B's users, roles, companies, branches, access and views were byte-identical before and after. The bulk 'all matching' activation with B's search matched 0, or returned 409 when given B's count. db-inspect.txt: erp_app, erp_auth and erp_owner are neither superuser nor BYPASSRLS. As erp_app with no tenant set, identity.users and lists.saved_views return 0 rows. lists.saved_views has RLS forced (tenant_isolation policy). pg_class is refused to erp_app.

biggest_gap.title: The round-14 device-store fix covers only the list kernel's folder. The shared sign-out forgetter and the shared client carrier gate still ignore the origin private file system and storage buckets
biggest_gap.detail: Every later 100,000-row list (Contacts, invoices, stock) will be a module screen built on p05's list. Round 14's L14 is now caught for code inside web/src/kernel/lists, by browserReach.test.ts (static) and deviceStores.test.tsx (behaviour). The e2e test 'keeps no row of a list on the device' covers only the Users list. Outside that folder, nothing changed. G1ClientStateTests.Carriers still has no navigator.storage, getDirectory, FileSystem* or storageBuckets pattern. kernel/deviceState.ts forgetIdentity() clears localStorage, sessionStorage, the default bucket's IndexedDB and Cache Storage, cookies and window.name. It never empties the origin private file system or any non-default storage bucket. The client-isolation e2e tabState reads neither one, and does not check navigator.storage.estimate. So a module screen or shared kernel helper that keeps list data there is unseen by the shared gate, and would also survive Sign out. I checked in Chromium 1243 on this product's origin that navigator.storageBuckets exists. Data written there does not show in indexedDB.databases() or the default getDirectory(), but it does count in navigator.storage.estimate().usage, so an estimate check would see it. Fixes (owned by p04's client gate and kernel): (a) add the origin private file system and storage buckets to G1ClientStateTests carriers, with a self-test; (b) make forgetIdentity empty getDirectory() and every storageBuckets.keys() bucket, or send Clear-Site-Data: "storage" on sign-out; (c) in client-isolation.spec.ts, after Sign out, require navigator.storage.estimate().usage to be no higher than before sign-in, as lists.spec.ts already does for the Users list.
biggest_gap.evidence: In 3251b6df: grep -n 'getDirectory\|storageBuckets\|navigator.storage' tests/Erp.Gates.Tests/G1/G1ClientStateTests.cs web/src/kernel/deviceState.ts tests/e2e/specs/client-isolation.spec.ts finds nothing. Lines 118-129 of G1ClientStateTests.cs list nine carrier kinds, none of them the file system or buckets. forgetIdentity() (deviceState.ts) awaits only clearDatabases() and clearCaches() for async stores. In p05's own folder, re-applying gauntlet/evidence/p05-list-search/r14/L14-list-first-page-kept-in-origin-file-system.patch fails 4 tests (run-L14-regression-web-lists.log), so the piece's own surface is covered.

other_findings: [route: p04-shell] Shared client-isolation machinery: the G1ClientStateTests carrier list, kernel/deviceState forgetIdentity and the e2e client-isolation tabState still have no origin-private-file-system or storage-bucket coverage.
